brief: Today's brief highlights key developments across geopolitics, economy, and national affairs, with India's diplomatic efforts taking center stage as Prime Minister Modi prepares for a month of high-stakes summits, including the SCO and Brics Summits, and an address to the UN General Assembly. Geopolitics.title: India gears up for month-long summit diplomacy: PM Modi to attend SCO meet, host Brics Summit & address UNGA

The airline expects to return to pre-war operations by October, citing growing demand and passenger traffic in the UAE. This development highlights the impact of geopolitical events on the aviation industry and global connectivity.

Economy.title: RBI Governor flags Iran war, weak monsoon as the biggest risks to India’s inflation and economic growth
Economy.summary: The RBI Governor has identified the Iran war and a weak monsoon as major risks to India's inflation and economic growth, despite the country's strong economic fundamentals. The RBI will monitor inflationary pressures before making any monetary policy adjustments. This caution is due to elevated inflation and geopolitical uncertainties.

Economy.title: Deloitte Forecasts 6.5-6.8 pc GDP Expansion In Current Fiscal
Economy.summary: Deloitte has forecast a 6.5-6.8% GDP expansion in the current fiscal year, citing a more uncertain global environment. However, the report notes that weather-related uncertainties, such as the impact of El Nino on agricultural output and food prices, remain a significant downside risk. This forecast takes into account recent geopolitical developments and central bank policy measures.

Economy.title: Gujarat tops NITI Aayog's Investment Friendliness Index 2026
Economy.summary: Gujarat has been ranked as the most investment-friendly state in India, according to NITI Aayog's Investment Friendliness Index 2026. The state's investor-friendly business environment, policy stability, and efficient single-window system have contributed to its top ranking. This is expected to attract significant investor confidence and support sustained investment growth.

Economy.title: Why India Needs Three Inflation Numbers To Understand One Economy
Economy.summary: India uses three different inflation numbers - CPI, WPI, and PPI - to measure inflation at various stages of the economy. Understanding these numbers is crucial for grasping price trends, corporate margins, RBI policy, and India's growth outlook. Each inflation number provides unique insights into the economy, making them all essential for a comprehensive understanding.

Economy.title: Crisil sees volatile FY27: Inflation to rise to 5.1%, growth to slow; RBI may hike rates
Economy.summary: Crisil has warned of a volatile fiscal year 2027, with inflation expected to rise to 5.1% and growth slowing down. Despite easing geopolitical tensions and lower crude oil prices, the macroeconomic outlook faces challenges. The RBI may respond to these developments with cautious policy measures, potentially including a hike in interest rates.

Economy.title: Global economy tipping towards a sharp slowdown, India ‘may lose a step’ too: Moody's Analytics
Economy.summary: Moody's Analytics has warned that the global economy is headed for a sharp slowdown over the next two years, with India also expected to lose momentum. An extended US-Iran conflict could trigger a fresh energy shock, reignite inflation, and force central banks into tighter monetary policy. This slowdown is expected to have a significant impact on India's economy.

Business.title: How an Ex-Bank Clerk Built India’s Olympic Medal Factory
Business.summary: A former bank clerk has revolutionized India's sports landscape by introducing private funding, leading to a ₹100-crore multi-sport revolution that now produces Olympic medals. This shift from government funding to private investment has had a significant impact on India's sports ecosystem. The initiative has created a successful model for producing Olympic medal winners.

Business.title: Emergent Raises Series C at $1.5 Billion Valuation, Becomes Unicorn in a Year of Launch
Business.summary: Emergent, an AI software creation platform, has raised $130 million in Series C funding, valuing the company at $1.5 billion and making it a unicorn within a year of its launch. This funding round was led by Creaegis and included participation from prominent investors such as Khosla Ventures and SoftBank Vision Fund 2. The investment will likely support Emergent's growth and expansion plans.

Business.title: Selective funding slows startup creation in India
Business.summary: The number of startups founded in India has significantly decreased, with 314 startups established in the first half of 2026 compared to 3,222 in 2025. This decline is attributed to selective funding, which has slowed down startup creation in the country. The data highlights the challenges faced by the Indian startup ecosystem in terms of funding and growth.

Business.title: up Ecosystem Could Be an Indirect Winner
Business.summary: The upcoming IPOs of OpenAI, Anthropic, and SpaceX may have a positive impact on India's startup ecosystem, as successful AI listings could revive VC funding, improve exits, and boost deep-tech investment. This, in turn, could strengthen India's long-term AI ambitions and benefit the country's startup ecosystem. The IPOs are expected to reshape global venture capital flows and have a indirect effect on India's startup scene.

Business.title: IPO funding from WhiteOak Capital, 3P India, others
Business.summary: SBI Funds has raised ₹1,880 crore in pre-IPO funding from investors such as WhiteOak Capital and 3P India. The funding was raised through a private placement of equity shares at an issue price of ₹574 per share. This investment will likely support SBI Funds' growth plans and expansion strategies.

Business.title: Aukera Raises Rs. 90 Cr in Fresh Funding
Business.summary: Aukera, a premium lab-grown diamond jewelry brand, has raised ₹90 crore in fresh funding from investors such as Alteria Capital and InnoVen Capital. This funding round comes less than a year after the company raised $15 million in equity funding. The investment will support Aukera's national expansion plans and strengthen its balance sheet as it competes in the growing lab-grown diamond market.

National Affairs.title: India visa and passport services disrupted in Australia after Delhi High Court scraps government tender
National Affairs.summary: The Delhi High Court has canceled a government tender for passport and visa services abroad due to a lack of fairness in the selection process, resulting in the suspension of these services in Australia. The government has appealed the decision to the Supreme Court. This disruption may affect Indians living in or traveling to Australia.

National Affairs.title: Bill to hike number of SC judges to be introduced in Lok Sabha on Monday
National Affairs.summary: A bill to increase the number of Supreme Court judges from 34 to 38, including the Chief Justice of India, is set to be introduced in the Lok Sabha. This move aims to replace an existing ordinance and is expected to enhance the judiciary's capacity. The Union Cabinet had previously cleared the bill in May.

National Affairs.title: The Government Must Make Life-Saving Medicines Affordable For The Common Man
National Affairs.summary: The Supreme Court has taken up the issue of access to affordable life-saving medicines in India, highlighting the need for options like compulsory licensing and price controls. This comes after concerns over costly treatments, including the case of a breast cancer patient who died while awaiting a decision on an expensive drug. The goal is to make essential medicines more accessible to citizens.

National Affairs.title: Kerala govt directs hospitals to form medical boards for life support withdrawal in terminally ill patients after SC order
National Affairs.summary: Following a Supreme Court directive, the Kerala government has instructed hospitals to establish medical boards to decide on withdrawing life support for terminally ill patients. These boards will comprise registered medical practitioners and will help make end-of-life care decisions, ensuring that patients receive appropriate palliative care.

National Affairs.title: 'Every Life Is Precious': Delhi High Court Says Government's Decision To Shift Sonam Wangchuk Not Arbitrary
National Affairs.summary: The Delhi High Court has upheld the government's decision to shift Sonam Wangchuk, stating that it was not arbitrary and no force was used. The court declined interim relief, emphasizing that every life is precious and must be protected. This decision may have implications for similar cases in the future.
